cancellation_summary: Submit cancellation requests 48 hours prior for a refund.
meeting_point: Royal Hawaiian Hotel, 2259 Kalākaua Ave., Honolulu, HI 96815
description: Participate in a simple, yet beautiful burial at sea service aboard an outrigger canoe. Scatter a loved one’s ashes into the open ocean off Waikīkī, under the shadow of Diamond Head, and honor the deceased with "the last wave" in true Waikīkī Beachboy tradition.
what_is_included:
- Outrigger canoe and crew
- Photography (takes 1-2 days for processing)
what_is_not_included:
- Flowers and lei (guests are welcome to bring their own)
-Officiant
-Music
itinerary:
- Paddle out into the ocean for the scattering of ashes
- Say a prayer, sing a song, or reflect in silence
- Surf a wave back to shore with “the last wave” in honor of the deceased
highlights:
- Burial at sea service in Waikīkī's beautiful waters
- Paddle out in a traditional outrigger canoe
- End the ceremony with the symbolic "last wave"
- Professional photography provided
check_in_details: Check in at least 10-15 minutes before your booked time at the service counter.
what_to_bring:
- Comfortable clothing that you do not mind getting wet
- Optional: Flowers or leis (a vendor list is available on the FAQs page)
special_requirements: - Maximum of 6 people, including those on the canoe and gathering on the beach.
disclaimers: - Safety first: in times of large surf or unpredictable conditions, tours may be rescheduled or canceled.
faqs:
- **Can we bring flowers or leis for the ceremony?** 
Yes. Loose, natural flowers may be placed in the ocean with the cremated remains. All string, ribbon, wire, plastic, and other non-biodegradable materials must be removed first. A vendor list is available on our FAQs page.
- **Will photos be provided?** 
Yes. Professional photography is included. Our water photographer will photograph the ceremony, and you will receive an email afterward with a link to download your photos.
- **May we play music during the ceremony?**
We do not provide music, but you are welcome to bring your own.
Any speaker, phone, tablet, or other electronic device must be waterproof or secured in a waterproof case. Waikīkī Beach Services is not responsible for lost or damaged electronic devices.
- **Can you arrange a Hawaiian officiant for our ceremony?**
We do not arrange officiant services. If you would like someone to lead your ceremony, please make arrangements independently through another provider.
